steps.content: (Flashback)

Fifteen Minutes Earlier
Castle Corridor

steps.speaker: Dullahan
steps.content: Do you accept her festering heart? Will you kiss the blue mold blooming from her spine? Do you promise never to wipe away the bloodstains on the wedding ring? Do you swear to love her shattered skull more than any intact soul?

steps.speaker: Dullahan
steps.content: Now, say your vows—will you take her hand, knowing you'll weave her wedding dress from lies?

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: No, no, no! If you say it like that, you'll scare them away!

steps.speaker: Dullahan
steps.content: But these are my own experiences, words from the depths of my heart... I left my wife too early. Had I known I would die in battle, I should have never accepted her proposal, only to waste her entire life...

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Come on, it's not like you're the one getting married! This is supposed to be a happy occasion, so stop with all the whining. First rule of being a top-tier real estate agent—the customer's needs come first! Now, listen and repeat after me:

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Dear friends, we are here today to share in this couple's happiness! Their love is like a meticulously designed luxury apartment, complete with a balcony overlooking the ocean and a sunlit conservatory, every corner filled with warmth and happiness!

steps.speaker: Dullahan
steps.content: Ocean view? Morveth Castle doesn't have an ocean view.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: DisSea is still a sea, the Rust is still a river—It's about your marketing skills! Don't get hung up on these details. Now, repeat after me: Their love will build a perfect home, and no matter what storms may come, this place will forever be their safe haven!

steps.speaker: Dullahan
steps.content: But life often brings storms we never see coming...

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Keep a positive mindset, and good things will follow! You've got potential, so why all the downer talk? Tell you what—get a copy of Luminita's Top-tier Real Estate Agent Guidebook, and I promise smooth sailing from here on out!

BANG!! The slightly unhinged figure in a trench coat crashes through the study door, catching you and Graves crouched by the bookshelf, her transformation barely held at bay as your hands grip each other tightly.
[Luminita's Back]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName} & Graves
steps.content: I must say, your friends are all quite... special.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I-I don't know her...

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Don't worry if you don't know me—the best properties will find you! Once you move in, you'll never want to leave, and if you do, you'll never forget it! Prime location, perfect feng shui, it'll fix all your worries and brighten your days! Now, for this charming couple...
[Luminita's Front]

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: How about it? Interested in a property?

steps.speaker: Dullahan
steps.content: Interested in a property?

steps.speaker: Dullahan
steps.content: Your sales speech doesn't seem to be working, Miss Agent.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Dullahan?
Sales speech?
So that confrontation in the hallway wasn't directed at you at all, but at this... real estate agent here?
The self-proclaimed "speech guru" awkwardly fidgets with her coat and backpack, her eyes darting from you to Graves, before locking onto your hands—which neither of you has thought to release.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Well, well, holding hands, are we? Hmm, nice place you've got here... a cozy, intimate little hideaway.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: I have no idea what you two were... Never mind! Carry on, I didn't see a thing. Not a single thing.
You feel the temperature rising where your skin touches Graves's, her complexion deepening to an even darker shade of red.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: You've got it all wrong! We... we weren't doing anything!

The words have barely left her lips when Graves yanks her hand away and vanishes without a trace. The shadowy figure you've worked so hard to approach, along with the truth you were about to uncover, slip right through your fingers—all because of this uninvited guest.
You glare at the real estate agent before you, but she just grins shamelessly while twirling her keyring, looking you up and down.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Don't tell me she's actually shy? Seriously? The legendary ghost bride has fallen for a <color=#fb9259>sleepwalking visitor</color>?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do you m—Oof!
Before you can finish your sentence, she pulls something from her pocket and shoves it into your mouth—
[White flash] [Flashback]

It's late at the Bureau. After a long day of duties, you return to your bedroom to rest. But one final task remains—examining a mysterious storybook Labyrinth found during her routine cleaning. Nightingale has asked you to inspect it as a precaution.
You flip through the pages casually, nothing suspicious catches your eye. The book recounts an unverifiable tale with little to ground it in reality.

Thorns blanket black stones, a bride roams Morveth Castle—white veil, dark shadow, whispers echo. Spider silk coils around fingers, insect bones float in goblets; guests may drink, promising to stay. Yet no one comes, her dress sweeps the stone stairs, the bride has a wish that cannot be locked away. You, who turn these pages—███, grant her wish, keep her company. When the moon reaches its zenith, go to her—never leave, never forget, never betray.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's that smell?

The picture book looks utterly ordinary, almost unremarkable, yet a peculiar fragrance wafts from its pages. The scent is faint but persistent, filling the air and creeping into your nose and throat with every breath. It leaves behind a faint, stinging burn that lingers.
By the time you realize something is wrong, it's already too late. Under the influence of the fragrance, drowsiness quickly overtakes you. You sink deep into sleep, until—
You wake up inside a coffin in Morveth Castle.
[End of Flashback]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Cough, cough...
The book... that strange scent! The events from before you arrived here flood back.

You spit out whatever Luminita stuffed into your mouth, and the memory fragment before your eyes ends. Only then do you see clearly what you've spat out—two white objects about the size of fingernails.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What did you just shove into my mouth?
Before you can press further, she hands you a small advertisement flyer:

GREAT NEWS! GREAT NEWS! FREE PAIR OF EVIL-WARDING DOG TEETH WITH EVERY HOUSE VIEWING!
Protect your home and ensure peace—the lucky charm every generation needs!
For viewings, call Luminita at: <color=#fb9259>0871-1408</color>
[Luminita sticks out her tongue]
